Your team projects 69.0 with the armband on Haaland. He carries risk — a 25% chance of 10 or more is real, but there is an 8% chance he scores 2 or fewer, and a knock has him at 75% to play. Salah sits 0.3 behind as captain if you want to hedge that, though the model prefers Haaland.

The proposed transfer swaps Wood for Watkins, netting 6.4 over the horizon at no points cost. It costs nothing because you have a free transfer and no bank to spare.

You have three Arsenal players and two each from Liverpool and Manchester City. Beyond Haaland's injury flag, the lineup is stable.

The bench offers little. If Haaland fails to play, Pope would come in at 2.3 — a significant gap to bridge. If you have concerns about the knock, now is when to act; waiting costs nothing but leaves you exposed.

Your armband is on a player with uncertainty attached. Haaland is flagged for a knock with a 75% chance of playing, and while he's 0.3 ahead of Salah as captain, there's an 8% tail risk of scoring 2 or fewer. If he doesn't start, the armband goes to your bench, where Mykolenko at 3.1 is your best option—a significant drop. You'll want to monitor his status closely before the deadline.

The Wood-for-Watkins trade nets 6.4 points across the horizon with no hit required, and you'll use your single free transfer for it. This improves your forward line without cost, though it does nothing about the captaincy question.

Your outfield is well-balanced at 3-4-3. Arsenal and Liverpool each supply three players between them (Raya, Gabriel, Saka for Arsenal; Van Dijk and Salah for Liverpool), with Manchester City represented by Gvardiol and Haaland. Concentration risk is there, but it reflects where the model sees value.

After the swap you'll carry £0.5m in the bank with no free transfer remaining. The projected eleven stands at 69.0 with the armband. The real variable this week is Haaland's fitness.

Your team projects 69.0 with Haaland captained. He carries a knock with a 75% chance of playing, and there is real downside: an 8% chance of 2 points or fewer against a 25% chance of 10 or more. Salah is 0.3 behind as captain, which is close enough that if Haaland's fitness hardens as uncertain, switching the armband is simple. You have one free transfer.

The model recommends Wood to Watkins for a gain of 6.4 points over the horizon with no hit. You have the budget and the transfer to do it. Watkins would join Palmer in midfield and Haaland in attack — three Chelsea and Manchester City players, plus the same three Arsenal, Liverpool and Manchester City players already giving you depth in those clubs.

Your bench projects 10.7, with Mykolenko as the best option at 3.1 if needed. Pope is your second goalkeeper and neither he nor Mykolenko would be your first choice to cover an unexpected absence.

The risk this week is Haaland's fitness. Everything else looks set.
